desc: Precompute factorials, inverse factorials, and binomial coefficients modulo P up to N(N-1)/2.
Precompute transition polynomial factors ((1+x)^a - 1)^b * (1+x)^{C(b,2)} as z-shift lists.
Implement the layer DP over states (used_even, used_odd, last_size) holding edge-count polynomials in z, multiplying 1/b! per layer.
At termination (used_even=used_odd=N/2) sum weights, multiply by (N-1)!, and emit M=N-1..C(N,2) via binomial transform mod P.
Verify against all three samples — worker reports all 3 public samples pass (N=4: 12 9 3 0; N=6 and N=10 match).
